children: Galliford has been appointed to 82 lots in total across the four-year framework, covering different value bands, regions, and sectors, including highways, rail, water and environment, energy, nuclear and defence.

Chief executive Bill Hocking said: "We are delighted to have successfully secured a place on this significant framework for our Infrastructure business. Operating in high-quality frameworks is a key part of our Sustainable Growth Strategy and we look forward to working with Pagabo to deliver for their clients in the coming years."
